title: Apps Script & AppSheet Work-Transformation Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Let the business build workflows — safely and to standard
problem: Google's Apps Script and AppSheet let teams automate and rebuild workflows fast — which becomes shadow IT and risk without governance. This solution establishes the work-transformation governance for Apps Script and AppSheet: approval patterns, security/data-access guardrails, environment and sharing standards, and a review model — so citizen and pro developers redesign workflows safely and to enterprise standard, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the automation governance model for Apps Script + AppSheet: where the risk is (data access, sharing, OAuth scopes) and how governance channels it.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Workspace admin controls for Apps Script/AppSheet, data-governance baseline, a review model, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
Implementation Guide — exact steps to set the admin guardrails (app access/OAuth, AppSheet governance, sharing), define the approval/review pattern and environments, pilot, and expand.
5 supporting scripts — Apps Script/AppSheet inventory discovery, guardrail conformance validation, an automation coverage/risk report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for safe citizen development and workflow redesign.
short: Establish governance for Apps Script & AppSheet — approval patterns, data-access guardrails, environment/sharing standards, and a review model — so workflow redesign happens safely and to standard, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Establish governance for Apps Script & AppSheet — approval patterns, data-access guardrails, environment/sharing standards, and a review model — so workflow redesign happens safely and to standard, pilot-first.
meta_description: Govern Apps Script and AppSheet on Google Workspace: approval patterns, OAuth/data-access guardrails, environment and sharing standards, and a review model for safe workflow redesign. Self-guided steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Business-led workflow automation that's fast and safe — Apps Script and AppSheet governed with guardrails, approvals, and standards — not shadow IT.
